nodes.name: Daily Trigger (08:00 UTC)
nodes.notes: Fires every day at 08:00 UTC. Change cron expression to adjust schedule.

nodes.name: Set Config
nodes.notes: Change 'topic' value here to monitor a different subject.

nodes.name: Search Web (Tavily)
nodes.notes: Searches Tavily for the configured topic. Returns up to 10 results.

nodes.name: Split Articles
nodes.notes: Splits the Tavily results array so each article is processed individually.

nodes.name: Grade Relevance (GPT-4o-mini)
nodes.notes: LLM grades each article as relevant or not_relevant. This is the autonomous judgment step.

nodes.name: Is Relevant?
nodes.notes: Conditional routing: relevant articles continue; irrelevant ones are dropped.

nodes.name: Embed Article (for dedup)
nodes.notes: Embeds the article URL+title for semantic deduplication against Pinecone.

nodes.name: Query Pinecone (dedup check)
nodes.notes: Queries Pinecone vector store. If top match score >= 0.95 → duplicate.

nodes.name: Is New Article?
nodes.notes: Only new (non-duplicate) articles proceed to insight extraction.

values.content:
=You are a research analyst extracting insights for a market research digest.

ARTICLE:
Title: {{ $json.title }}
URL: {{ $json.url }}
Content: {{ $json.content }}

TASK: Extract exactly 3-5 factual, specific insights from this article.
- Each insight must be a complete, standalone sentence
- Cite only facts explicitly stated in the article
- Focus on: announcements, data points, regulatory actions, product launches, strategic moves
- Do NOT include vague statements or your own opinions

Respond ONLY with a JSON array of strings:
["insight 1", "insight 2", "insight 3"]

nodes.name: Extract Insights (GPT-4o)
nodes.notes: Uses the higher-quality GPT-4o to extract structured insights from each relevant new article.

nodes.name: Store in Pinecone
nodes.notes: Upserts the article embedding to Pinecone so future runs detect it as a duplicate.

nodes.name: Aggregate All Articles
nodes.notes: Collects all processed articles into a single array for digest generation.

nodes.name: Write to Notion
nodes.notes: Creates a new Notion page in your research database with the full digest.

nodes.name: Telegram: Success Notification
nodes.notes: Sends a formatted success message to your Telegram chat when the digest is ready.

nodes.name: Telegram: Error Alert
nodes.notes: Sends an error alert to Telegram if any part of the workflow fails.

nodes.name: Log: Skipped (Irrelevant)
nodes.notes: Logs irrelevant articles. These are not processed further.

nodes.name: Log: Skipped (Duplicate)
nodes.notes: Logs duplicate articles that were already seen in previous runs.

_meta.description: Daily AI Market Research Monitor using LangGraph RAG pattern. Searches web, grades relevance, deduplicates via Pinecone, writes digest to Notion, notifies via Telegram.
setup_steps: 1. Import this JSON into n8n via Settings > Import Workflow
2. Set up OpenAI, Notion, and Telegram Bot credentials in n8n
3. Create n8n Variables for all REQUIRED_VARS above
4. Create a Notion database with fields: Title (title), Topic (text), Run Date (date), Articles Found (number), Top Headline (text), Status (select)
5. Create a Telegram bot via @BotFather and get your chat ID
6. Activate the workflow — it will run daily at 08:00 UTC
7. Change the topic in 'Set Config' node to monitor a different subject
